t: For the purposes of this Act, the term “congressional intelligence committees” means the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives, the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate, the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives, and the Subcommittee on Defense of the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate.

fable.w: This section is purely a definition of the term "congressional intelligence committees" and sets up no consultation, hearing, comment, or litigation process. The tempting reading is that naming committees implies a consultative body, but congressional committees are inside the federal government, and no outside party is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: the term “congressional intelligence committees” means the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives, the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate

opus.w: This provision only defines "congressional intelligence committees." It names only committees and subcommittees of Congress, which are inside the federal government. It does not require any federal decision process that brings in outside parties. The mention of "committees" makes it look procedural, but none of these committees are advisory bodies with non-federal members.
opus.s: the term “congressional intelligence committees” means the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence of the House of Representatives, the Select Committee on Intelligence of the Senate
